references.text: The priest makes atonement for the people, and they receive forgiveness - the same pattern with כפר (atonement) and סלח (forgiveness)
The priest makes atonement for sin, and the person receives forgiveness - an identical atonement formula
Atonement and forgiveness through the priest's service - the same theological structure
The priest makes atonement and the sin is forgiven - a parallel concluding formula for the sin offering
Atonement is made by the priest and forgiveness is granted - the same ritual process
The priest makes atonement and the person receives forgiveness - the concluding formula for the guilt offering
Atonement for guilt (אשׁם) through the priest's service - a direct parallel in the same chapter
The priest makes atonement for sins of ignorance - the same context of the guilt offering
The priest makes atonement for the entire congregation of Israel and they receive forgiveness - an extended application of the principle of atonement
Hebrews explains that almost everything is cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness - a theological commentary on the Levitical sacrificial system
Confession of sin leads to forgiveness and cleansing - the New Testament fulfillment of the principle of atonement
